## What it is

Sam and I explored whether the *Dobbs v Jackson* leak and decision affected the mental health of residents in conservative and liberal states differently. We used data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention bi-weekly report on anxiety and depressive symptoms. We paired this with data from Google Trends to show the topic of abortion saw a noticeable uptick in searches during the leak and decision, and that no other major events co-occurred to explain significant changes in mental health.

## What I did

- Conducted a literature review and wrote the intro, background, and conclusion
- Searched multiple databases for major events that occurred during the period of interest
- Compiled the results in an Quarto Markdown file to produce a research-style report
- Conducted and interpreted the independent samples t-test
